body:
Follow-up to #19216: the HeadChunkID doc still promised a monotonically increasing per-series number, which no longer holds for out-of-order chunk IDs now that they wrap modulo 2^23. Also spell out the "much less than" relation in the oooHeadChunkID comment, where << is easy to misread as a bit-shift.

comments.body:
**Validate.**

This matches #19216: OOO chunk IDs wrap modulo 2^23, so the old "monotonically increasing per series" `HeadChunkID` comment is wrong. Spelling out that `<<` in the `oooHeadChunkID` comment is "much less than" (not a shift) is also worth doing. `NONE` release notes are correct for a comment-only change.

title: tsdb: document that OOO chunk IDs are no longer monotonically increasing
